deities: Goddess Kali as Manaskamana Kali ('the wish-fulfilling mother')

history.period: Age unverified — one directory listing calls it 'ancient' (unverified)
history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: location confirmed (26 Manaskamana Road, Rathbari, English Bazar, Malda — near Bibhuti Bhusan High School; OSM, Google and directory listings agree), but no reliable published history found; one directory listing calls it a famous, ancient temple of Malda town (unverified). 'Manaskamana' = fulfiller of desires; locally regarded as a jagrat (awakened) shrine where devotees come for wish-fulfilment, with daily worship. Ratings of ~4.7 (75+ reviews) on listing sites confirm a busy, popular local temple. Any claimed antiquity or founding story needs primary-source verification.

name: Manaskamana Kali Temple
town_description: Malda (English Bazar) is a city in northern West Bengal on the Mahananda river, famous for its GI-tagged Fazli, Langra and Himsagar mangoes; the district preserves the medieval capitals of Gaur (Gauda) and Pandua with Sultanate-era monuments.

travel.airport: Bagdogra International Airport (IXB), roughly 230 km north, is the nearest major airport.
travel.railway: Malda Town Junction (MLDT), about 3 km away.
travel.road: Manaskamana Road, Rathbari, English Bazar (Malda town); reachable by auto-rickshaw from Malda Town station.

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; Kali Puja is the main festival day.
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6 AM-10 PM daily (Justdial and worldorgs agree).
